units: <cite ref="Bava Kamma 7a:9">B. Kam. 7ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Exodus 22:4">Ex. XXII, 4</cite>) <he>מ׳ שדהו של ניזק</he> it means the highest assessment of damage of the property of the injured party; <he>מ׳ שדהו של מזיק</he> the best property of the injurer is held responsible for the damage.

<cite ref="Exodus 22:4">Ib.</cite> <he>מ׳ אין מידי אחרינא לא</he> must he pay only in the best value (as property, cash &c.) and in no other stock? Ib.ᵇ <he>כל מילי מ׳ הוא</he> all movable objects are payment in good value (must be accepted); a. fr.
